extraFacts.fact: 316L is the low-carbon grade of 316 stainless steel; 316 contains molybdenum, which improves resistance to chlorides and pitting, so it is chosen for sea water, coastal plant and chloride-bearing process fluids.
extraFacts.source: ASTM A276 grade designations; Indus Hydraulics guide /blog/304-vs-316-stainless-steel-fittings

extraFacts.fact: Stainless steel threads can gall (seize and tear) when made up dry, so threads on stainless fittings are lubricated before assembly.

faqs.q: What are the Brennan 6316 FJS-Weld Straight Tube Adapters used for?
faqs.a: The Brennan 6316 FJS-Weld Straight Tube Adapters are straight adapters with a 37° JIC end on one side and a weld end on the other, listed to SAE J514, for joining a JIC line to a tube or pipe that is welded in. This listing holds 13 Brennan part numbers in steel and stainless steel.

faqs.q: How do I read Brennan part numbers such as 6316-24-SS and 6316-08?
faqs.a: The number 6316 is the series, the two digits are the size, and a trailing -SS marks a stainless steel row. In the size table 6316-08 is a steel adapter for 1/2 tube OD with a 3/4-16 thread, 6316-12-SS is stainless for 3/4 tube OD with a 1-1/16-12 thread, and 6316-24-SS is stainless for 1-1/2 tube OD with a 1-7/8-12 thread.

faqs.q: What tube sizes do the Brennan 6316 FJS-Weld Straight Tube Adapters cover?
faqs.a: The listing covers tube OD from 1/4 with a 7/16-20 thread up to 2 with a 2-1/2-12 thread, with rows between at 3/8, 1/2, 5/8, 3/4, 1-1/4 and 1-1/2. The stainless rows run 6316-04-SS, 6316-10-SS, 6316-12-SS, 6316-20-SS, 6316-24-SS and 6316-32-SS, and the steel rows include 6316-06, 6316-08 and 6316-20.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right size of Brennan 6316 FJS-Weld Straight Tube Adapters?
faqs.a: Choose by the tube or weld-end size and by the JIC thread: each row pairs the tube OD with its JIC thread, such as 1/2 with 3/4-16 or 1-1/4 with 1-5/8-12. Rows 6316-24 and 6316-32 are described as buttweld straights in 24FJS and 32FJS sizes, so say whether you need the buttweld type when you quote.

faqs.q: What is the pressure rating of the Brennan 6316 FJS-Weld Straight Tube Adapters?
faqs.a: The size table does not carry one pressure figure for the series: ratings vary by size, so check the row for the part you order. Send your working pressure and temperature with the part number and we will confirm the adapter is suitable, because the weld, the tube and the JIC joint each limit the line.

faqs.q: Are the Brennan 6316 FJS-Weld Straight Tube Adapters steel or stainless steel?
faqs.a: Both appear in the listing. Rows ending -SS, such as 6316-24-SS and 6316-32-SS, are stainless steel, and rows such as 6316-08 and 6316-06 are described as steel. Say which material you need when you quote, because the steel and stainless rows share the same size codes.

faqs.q: Which standard do the Brennan 6316 FJS-Weld Straight Tube Adapters follow, and can I get certificates?
faqs.a: The size table cites SAE J514, the standard for 37° flared tube fittings, on the rows that give a full description. This listing holds no test certificate or declaration; if your job needs a material certificate, ask for it in the enquiry so it can be requested before supply.

faqs.q: What does the Brennan 6316 FJS-Weld Straight Tube Adapters connect to?
faqs.a: The JIC end mates with a female 37° JIC swivel nut, and the weld end is welded to tube or pipe of the matching size. For a stainless JIC union to join the line, see the [stainless JIC 37° male union](/p/stainless-steel-jic-37-male-union) or browse the [stainless JIC adapters shelf](/c/stainless-steel-jic-adapters). JIC and SAE 45° flares can look alike, so confirm the seat before ordering.

faqs.q: How do I fit the Brennan 6316 FJS-Weld Straight Tube Adapters?
faqs.a: Weld the weld end to the tube or pipe with a procedure suited to its material, and let it cool before you make up the JIC end. The JIC end seals on its flare seat, so do not add tape or sealant to the seat. Quote the part number if you want us to confirm the end types before supply.

faqs.q: How does the Brennan 6316 FJS-Weld Straight Tube Adapters differ from a stainless JIC male × tube socket connector?
faqs.a: The Brennan adapter has a weld end, while the [stainless JIC 37° male × tube socket countersunk bore connector](/p/stainless-steel-jic-37-male-x-tube-socket-countersunk-bore-connector) takes a plain tube in a countersunk socket. Both join a JIC end to a tube that is fixed in place; choose by the weld or socket joint your drawing calls for.

faqs.q: Is the Brennan 6316 FJS-Weld Straight Tube Adapters in stock, and how do I get a quotation?
faqs.a: Yes, the Brennan 6316 FJS-Weld Straight Tube Adapters is held in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and we ship worldwide with the best lead times. Quote the part numbers you need on [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: What do I send to order the Brennan 6316 FJS-Weld Straight Tube Adapters?
faqs.a: Quote the Brennan part number, for example 6316-16 or 6316-24-SS, with the material and quantity. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation, and we confirm the end types before supply; see [what to send for a fittings quote](/blog/what-to-send-for-a-fittings-quote).

faqs.q: What are the Aeroquip Straight Hydraulic Hose Adapters used for?
faqs.a: The Aeroquip Straight Hydraulic Hose Adapters are straight adapters in Grade 316 stainless steel with a male NPT thread on one end and a male JIC end on the other, used to connect a hose fitting or hose end to an NPT port. The listing holds 9 part numbers from 1/8" to 3/4".

faqs.q: How do I read part numbers such as J8-8CBO and J6CBO?
faqs.a: In the size table the number after J is the JIC size and a number after the hyphen is the NPT size: J8-8CBO is 1/2" NPT by 1/2" JIC, J6CBO is 1/4" NPT by 3/8" JIC, and J10CBO is 1/2" NPT by 5/8" JIC. The suffix CBO marks the straight shape; the same sizes in the Eaton elbow hose adapters end in MEBO.

faqs.q: What sizes do the Aeroquip Straight Hydraulic Hose Adapters come in?
faqs.a: The listing has 9 part numbers from 1/8" to 3/4". The NPT ends run 1/8", 1/4", 3/8", 1/2" and 3/4", and the JIC ends run 1/4", 5/16", 3/8", 1/2", 5/8" and 3/4". For example J4CBO is 1/8" NPT by 1/4" JIC and J12CBO is 3/4" NPT by 3/4" JIC.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right Aeroquip Straight Hydraulic Hose Adapters for my port?
faqs.a: Pick by the NPT size of the port first, then by the JIC size of the hose end: both are on each row, so J8-8CBO suits a 1/2" NPT port and a 1/2" JIC hose end. The thread type is listed as MNPT × male JIC, so both ends must be male. Do not mix NPT with BSP or parallel threads.

faqs.q: What pressure do the Aeroquip Straight Hydraulic Hose Adapters hold?
faqs.a: The maker states 3,000 to 4,500 psi (207 to 310 bar), by size, and each row carries its own figure: J12CBO is listed at 207 bar and J8-8CBO at 276 bar, while J4-4CBO is listed at 310 bar. Read the figure for your size and never assume the top figure applies.

faqs.q: What material and finish are the Aeroquip Straight Hydraulic Hose Adapters?
faqs.a: The listing is Grade 316 stainless steel. Grade 316 resists chlorides better than 304, so it suits sea water and chemical service. Tell us the fluid and temperature if the medium is unusual.

faqs.q: Which standards do the Aeroquip Straight Hydraulic Hose Adapters follow, and can I get certificates?
faqs.a: The thread type is stated as MNPT × male JIC, which is an NPT taper thread with a 37° JIC flare end. This listing holds no standard or test certificate; if your job needs a material certificate, ask for it in the enquiry so it can be requested before supply.

faqs.q: What does the Aeroquip Straight Hydraulic Hose Adapters connect to?
faqs.a: The male JIC end mates with a female 37° JIC swivel nut on a hose end, and the male NPT end screws into a female NPT port. The stainless [JIC 37° male × NPT male connector](/p/stainless-steel-jic-37-male-x-npt-male-connector) covers the same joint in a stainless fitting range.

faqs.q: How do I fit the Aeroquip Straight Hydraulic Hose Adapters without leaks?
faqs.a: Use sealant or tape on the male NPT thread and stop when the joint is tight. The JIC end seals on its flare seat, so no tape on the seat. Stainless threads can gall, so lubricate them.

faqs.q: How do the Aeroquip Straight Hydraulic Hose Adapters differ from the Eaton elbow hose adapters?
faqs.a: The Aeroquip Straight Hydraulic Hose Adapters are straight adapters; the [Eaton elbow hose adapters](/p/eaton-elbow-hydraulic-hose-adapters) use the MEBO shape in the same sizes and the same MNPT × male JIC threads. Choose by whether the hose has to leave the port in line or at a right angle.
